papers.title_en: Bayesian classification of astronomical spectra with class uncertainties
papers.authors: Simon Barton, Martin Sahlén, Andreas Korn, Christian Glaser
papers.evidence: 用贝叶斯神经网络与变分推断进行预测不确定性量化
papers.tldr: 为4MOST巡天对恒星与河外目标光谱做约十类分类，并需表达输入与预测不确定性。研究比较CNN、Dirichlet、Monte Carlo dropout与贝叶斯神经网络+变分推断，用SDSS和4MOST模拟数据训练验证。简单CNN约2万参数，准确率达91.5%和92.8%；MCD最合适，提升至92.6%和93.9%，训练快、推断足够快。相比标准CNN，它以极小额外代价提供校准良好的不确定性。
papers.abstract_en: Context: We developed a probabilistic machine learning method with the aim of performing the O(10)-way classification of low- and high-resolution spectra of stellar and extragalactic targets for the upcoming 4MOST survey. In fulfilment of the survey requirements, this method should be able to express uncertainty in the input data as well as uncertainty introduced in its prediction. Aims: Four different methods are explored: (1) convolutional neural networks (CNNs), (2) the Dirichlet distribution, (3) Monte Carlo dropout (MCD), (4) Bayesian neural Networks (BNNs) + variational inference (VI). Training and validation was performed using labelled spectra from the SDSS database and a custom 4MOST mock dataset. All the methods were compared in terms of the same metrics: accuracy, area under the curve (AUC), expected calibration error (ECE), Shannon entropy, negative log-likelihood (NLL), Brier score, training time, and inference time. Methods: A CNN with simple architecture and about 20,000 parameters was trained to achieve classification accuracies of 91.5% on SDSS data and 92.8% on 4MOST mock data. The direct Dirichlet prediction and VI models tested provide uncertainties on class membership probabilities, but they confuse classes more often. The MCD on a CNN is found to be the most suitable; it boosts the point-estimate accuracies to 92.6% and 93.9%, while still providing fast training and sufficiently fast inference. Compared to a standard CNN, the method additionally provides well-calibrated uncertainties at marginal extra cost.

papers.title_en: Neural composite likelihood estimation: simulation based inference for time series
papers.authors: Grace Yan, Mark Beaumont, Dennis Prangle
papers.evidence: 通过复合似然进行模拟推断的神经似然估计
papers.tldr: 针对复杂时间序列中似然函数难解、而神经似然估计（NLE）受限于低维数据的问题，本文提出神经复合似然估计（NCLE）。该方法将长序列切分为等长小批次，分别用神经网络估计各批次似然，再相乘得到近似复合似然。随后通过最大化该复合似然获得点估计，并利用Godambe信息矩阵构建置信区间。实验表明，NCLE能在时间序列模型上有效扩展仿真推断的适用维度，兼顾复杂依赖与推断可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Simulation based inference (SBI) circumvents the challenge of intractable likelihoods by using a simulator that generates data given parameter values. For instance, neural likelihood estimation (NLE) estimates the likelihood function by training a neural network to perform conditional density estimation on simulated data given corresponding parameters. However such density estimation is only feasible for relatively low dimensional data. We extend the scalability of SBI methods to a higher dimensional problem: long sequences with a complex dependency structure.   We introduce Neural Composite Likelihood Estimation (NCLE). This divides the sequence into smaller, equal-sized batches. Instead of training NLE to estimate the likelihood for an entire sequence, we estimate the likelihood for each batch separately. The product of these forms an approximate composite likelihood (CL), and we perform frequentist inference using methods from the CL literature: we get a point estimate from maximising the approximate CL and obtain confidence intervals by estimating the Godambe information matrix. We demonstrate the effectiveness of NCLE with experiments on time series models.

papers.title_en: Generative models for simulation based filtering: Formulations and Empirical Comparisons
papers.authors: Mohammad Al-Jarrah, Wei Deng, Bamdad Hosseini, Amirhossein Taghvaei
papers.evidence: 生成模型将预测分布传输到后验用于非线性滤波
papers.tldr: 非线性滤波中，生成模型用于分析步缺乏统一构建与系统比较。本文把分析步视为将预报分布输运到后验，提出基于随机插值、确定性流匹配极限以及前向-后向随机微分方程实现薛定谔桥的三种新滤波器，并设计两阶段调参，把生成模型训练与在线细化分开。与OTF、KRF、SIR粒子滤波和EnKF的受控对比显示，各类生成式滤波都能刻画EnKF与SIR难以处理的多模态后验，但没有单一框架占优，最优选择取决于在线预算与集合大小，且不同方法生成的粒子轨迹正则性存在差异。
papers.abstract_en: This letter presents a unified formulation and a controlled numerical comparison of generative-model approaches to the nonlinear filtering problem. Under this formulation the analysis step is realized by a transport of the forecast distribution to the posterior, the approaches differing only in how that transport is selected and learned. We derive three new filters, based on stochastic interpolants, their deterministic flow-matching limit, and Schrödinger bridges realized through forward--backward SDEs. We develop a two-stage tuning procedure that separates the training of the generative model from its online refinement. The resulting methods are compared against the optimal transport filter (OTF), the Knothe--Rosenblatt filter (KRF), the sequential importance resampling (SIR) particle filter and the ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF), in terms of accuracy, computational time, and sensitivity to ensemble size and state dimension. The results indicate that every generative filter resolves multimodal posteriors that the EnKF and SIR do not, that no single generative framework dominates, the preferred method being set by the available online budget and ensemble size, and that the filters differ in the regularity of the particle trajectories they produce.

papers.title_en: Preservation of Log-Concavity and Convergence of Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao Gradient Flows
papers.evidence: 通过梯度流从仅知归一化常数的分布中采样
papers.tldr: 针对从仅知归一化常数的分布中采样，WFR梯度流结合Wasserstein输运与Fisher-Rao生灭动力学以平衡探索和选择。本文证明在强对数凹且满足额外曲率条件的目标下，WFR流能保持强对数凹性，而Wasserstein流仅在Gaussian情形下具备该性质。利用此结果，作者为对称化KL散度给出无需热启动的显式非渐近收敛率，并发现收敛率可加分解为Wasserstein与Fisher-Rao两项贡献。这验证了近期猜想，并为WFR采样与贝叶斯推断提供更精细的理论保证。
papers.abstract_en: We study the convergence of Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) gradient flows for sampling from probability distributions known up to a normalisation constant. By combining Wasserstein transport with Fisher-Rao birth-death dynamics, WFR flows balance exploration and selection. These flows have been recognised as a promising mechanism to accelerate convergence beyond Langevin dynamics. We show that for a class of strongly log-concave target distributions satisfying additional curvature conditions, WFR flows preserve strong log-concavity, in contrast to Wasserstein flows which enjoy this property only in the Gaussian setting. Exploiting this result, we derive explicit non-asymptotic convergence rates for the symmetrised Kullback-Leibler divergence, without requiring a warm-start as required in current estimates. In particular, we show that the convergence rate decomposes additively into Wasserstein and Fisher-Rao contributions, thereby confirming a recent conjecture within this setting. These results provide refined convergence guarantees and further develop the theoretical foundations of WFR gradient flows for sampling and Bayesian inference.

papers.title_en: Classification-oriented adaptive sensing via posterior sampling
papers.authors: Andriy Enttsel, Maxime Rousselot, Vincent Corlay
papers.evidence: 扩散后验采样用于自适应压缩感知
papers.tldr: 现有基于扩散后验采样的自适应压缩感知多通过最大化总后验信号方差选探针，因而偏向重建。本文利用类条件高斯混合模型后验协方差的类内与类间分解，借助校准软分类器从后验样本估计两类不确定性，提出面向分类的准则来选择未测子空间中的主导感知方向。在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，方法比较了分类精度、测量成本与重建质量；结果显示，语义后验不确定性在部分区间能改善分类-测量权衡，同时量化了重建代价。该工作把实例自适应感知从重建驱动推进到分类驱动。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled high-performance, instance-adaptive compressed sensing through posterior sampling, without task-specific policy training. Existing methods select sensing probes by maximizing total posterior signal variance and are therefore primarily reconstruction-driven. We introduce a classification-driven extension motivated by the closed-form posterior covariance of a class-conditional Gaussian mixture model, which decomposes into within-class and between-class uncertainty. Using calibrated soft classifier outputs, we estimate these uncertainty terms from diffusion posterior samples and propose a classification-oriented criterion for selecting the dominant sensing direction in the unmeasured subspace. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 compare the resulting classification accuracy, measurement cost, and reconstruction quality with those of reconstruction-oriented counterparts. The results identify regimes in which semantic posterior uncertainty yields a more favorable classification--measurement trade-off and quantify the associated reconstruction cost.
